as_of_content:
'''Modules''', or '''Mods''' for short, are devices used on a Commander's base to give their Bots stat boosts and additional abilities to help defend their base from other [[Raid|Raiding]] Commanders. Mods can be upgraded and forged just like Bots. There are three classes of Mods: Attack, Defense, and Utility.

== Attack Mods ==
<gallery navigation="true">
Harm Accelerator New.png|Harm Accelerator|link=Harm Accelerator
Laser Guidance Module New.png|Laser Guidance Module
Nightbird's Mark New.png|Nightbird's Mark
Robot Resource New.png|Robot Resource
Scout's Sentry.png|Scout's Sentry|link=Scout's Sentry
Superconductor v2.png|Superconductor 1000|link=Superconductor 1000
Superconductor v2.png|Superconductor 2000|link=Superconductor 2000
</gallery>
==Defense Mods==
<gallery navigation="true">
EMI Module New.png|E.M.I. Module|link=E.M.I. Module
Repair Module New.png|Repair Module
Security Module New.png|Security Module
Strange Refractor New.png|Strange Refractor
Tech Console.png|Tech Console|link=Tech Console
</gallery>
==Utility Mods==
<gallery navigation="true">
Exo-Filter New.png|Exo-Filter|link=Exo-Filter
Paralyzer New.png|Paralyzer
Transwarp Cell.png|Transwarp Cell|link=Transwarp Cell
Prime Module.png|Prime Module|link=Prime Module
</gallery>
==Unreleased==
These names and portraits were found in the game files and have existed since Beta. They appear to be Class-boosting Mods, but remain unreleased.
<gallery>
File:Portrait attack large.png|Attack Module
File:portrait_health_large.png|Health Module
File:Portrait brawlersfury large.png|Brawler's Fury
File:Portrait democache large.png|Demo Cache
File:Portrait tacticianstrick large.png|Tactician's Trick
File:Portrait warriorscall large.png|Warrior's Call
</gallery>

==See Also==
Not to be confused with [[Utility Module]], the game element for AI-Bots on Solo Missions.
